text: The set-truncation ‖A‖₀ is characterised by which universal property?
choices: It is the smallest set receiving a map from A
For any set B, maps A→B factor uniquely through ‖A‖₀→B
‖A‖₀ is the set of connected components of A
explanation: Universal property of 0-truncation: maps from A to any set factor through ‖A‖₀ uniquely.
